jobs.title: LIBRE Regional Field Manager, PA - Harrisburg
jobs.description_text: Rooted in the Hispanic community, The LIBRE Initiative brings people together to advance public policy solutions that create the freedom and opportunity that people need to chase their American Dream. LIBRE empowers our communities by fixing our broken immigration system, encouraging affordable and flexible healthcare options, building an individualized education system, and promoting a robust economy that helps everyone succeed. The LIBRE Initiative is a part of Americans for Prosperity and the Stand Together philanthropic community. As a Regional Field Manager (internally called a Grassroots Engagement Director), you’ll recruit and mobilize grassroots leaders across the Harrisburg Tri-County area in Pennsylvania and inspire them to take action and drive policy reforms that open opportunities for all. This is a hands-on community organizing role for someone who loves meeting people and building movements. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $50,000–$65,000 per year.

jobs.description_text: Are you a proven sales enablement leader who knows how to turn firsthand selling experience into stronger capabilities across an entire team? jobs.title: Senior Strategist
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Strategist on Stand Together’s Strategic Analysis team, you will be a trusted advisor to our issue teams on their hardest questions. Our team builds the research, insights, and standards behind our Priority Initiatives. These are the teams that lead our work on issues like Unleashing Economic Growth and Mobility and Bridging Divides. You will work embedded with one of them, from early strategy to finished materials. You will use research, our internal knowledge, and experts across the organization to build points of view and strategies. Then you will write them up so our staff and stakeholders can act on them. You will bring rigor to the issue leader’s hardest questions. The issue leader stays accountable for the strategy. This role fits a senior individual contributor who thinks like an advisor. You stay calm in ambiguity. You can turn a lot of data and information into one clear point of view. And you like helping other teams turn strategy into impact.

A core tenet and base requirement for this position is mastery of Cisco Route/Switch and/or Datacenter technologies. Outside of this core tenet, our expectation is to attract, recruit and attain resources who have a desire to focus not only on traditional on-premises Cisco solutions, but also to be looking to career, technology and skill advancement by being actively willing to demonstrate skills and ability to learn new technologies including multiple SDN solutions, network security, load balancing, edge / acceleration, and cloud technologies. Experience or eagerness to learn about and with network and system / access design with Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure or other cloud services is a key requirement. The SSE is considered a subject matter expert in these areas with responsibility for selling and designing complex solutions. The SSE is also considered an organizational thought leader for their specialty area.

The successful candidate will be a proactive problem-solver with strong analytical and communication skills who can quickly develop subject matter expertise and provide practical, business-oriented guidance in a highly regulated and evolving environment. jobs.description_text: The New Account Acquisition Lead is accountable for identifying, developing, and securing new dealership relationships that expand Protective’s direct channel presence within an assigned region. Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, this role leads complex and strategically significant sales opportunities from initial prospecting and qualification through solution design, negotiation, contracting, and transition to the Sales Lead for ongoing account development. The role develops tailored acquisition strategies, builds trusted relationships with senior dealership decision-makers, and coordinates with Product, Underwriting, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Sales Operations, Sales Enablement, Legal, and Compliance to deliver profitable growth and a strong prospective-dealer experience. jobs.title: Principal - Tax Planning & Strategy
jobs.description_text: The Principal Tax Planning & Strategy role is a senior technical professional within Protective’s Corporate Tax Department. Reporting to the VP, Head of Corporate Tax, this role leads complex tax planning, transaction support, and international tax initiatives, and supports Protective’s business lines and legal and operational teams on policyholder tax matters. The Director partners with business leaders, corporate functions, parent-company tax teams, and external advisors to identify opportunities, evaluate alternatives, and deliver practical solutions that create business value and manage tax risk. This individual-contributor role combines deep technical expertise with strategic judgment and cross-functional leadership. Although the position has no direct reports, it plays an important role in mentoring, training, and developing tax professionals across the department. Protective’s targeted salary range for this position is $160,000 to $170,000.

jobs.title: Regional Finance & Insurance Performance Manager
jobs.description_text: The Regional F&I Performance Manager (Production Development Manager) is responsible for increasing business at dealerships through training, monitoring production, and analyzing dealership Finance and Insurance product sales. Creates and performs training and other related services on behalf of the company by traveling to its clientele locations. Applicants that meet the following requirements may be considered for an interview: Experience as a Finance & Insurance Manager or F&I Director within an automotive dealership (required) Demonstrated success in increasing F&I production, profitability, product penetration, and compliance performance Strong working knowledge of dealership operations, lender relationships, menu selling, and regulatory compliance requirements This position does require consistent and regular travel as required to service our set of established Dealership Partners within the state of Arizona. Protective’s targeted compensation for this position is $12,000 - $16,000 monthly. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors, including but not limited to commission structures, job location, skills, and experience.

jobs.title: Senior Director - Portfolio Risk & Underwriting Strategy
jobs.description_text: Help shape the profitability and risk strategy of a growing, multi-product Asset Protection portfolio. Protective is seeking a senior insurance leader who can connect underwriting judgment with actuarial analysis, pricing, forecasting, and portfolio performance management. This high-visibility role will influence decisions across vehicle protection plans, GAP coverage, limited warranties, and ancillary products serving automotive, marine, powersports, and recreational vehicle markets. You will lead underwriting strategy and governance, turn complex portfolio data into clear actions, and advise executive leaders on growth, profitability, and risk. This opportunity is well suited to a P&C actuarial or underwriting leader who enjoys moving beyond analysis to shape products, risk appetite, operating practices, and business outcomes. You will also build organizational capability by developing talent and strengthening the tools and processes used to manage the portfolio. Protective’s targeted salary range for this position is $137,000 to $210,000. The internal title for this position is "Sr. Director Underwriting".

The Director of Creative will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to create compelling content that drives engagement and growth. Protective’s targeted salary range for this position is $76,500 to $130,000.

jobs.description_text: Job Summary: The Billing Specialist works remotely with the Billing Manager and Premium Application Specialist to research and resolve premium payment exceptions, follow up on missing or inaccurate information, process premium payments, and communicate with insureds, producers, and internal departments to support accurate and timely premium administration. The Billing Specialist completes assigned work accurately and within documented service standards, maintains clear records, safeguards confidential information in accordance with company policies, and promptly escalates unresolved or unusual premium issues through established channels. Protective’s targeted salary range for this position is $41,600 to $61,000.

jobs.description_text: Pinterest's Consumer Brand Partnerships team sits within a tiny-but-mighty consumer marketing org, alongside social, influencer, creative, and brand teams. Reporting to the Brand Partnerships Lead, the Brand Partnerships Manager (Europe) will be the inaugural brand partnerships team member to work on projects outside of the UK in Europe. As Brand Partnerships Manager, Europe, you’ll lead the rollout of Pinterest’s co-marketing advertiser brand partnerships opportunities across France, Germany and the Netherlands. This role is part of Consumer Marketing and will work with Global Sales Organisation (GSO) to make it easier for teams to identify, assess and deliver relevant co-marketing opportunities with advertisers. This includes scaling the Advertiser Co-Marketing Brand Toolkit in those regions, giving top-tier advertisers governed access to Pinterest IP off-platform while driving commercial revenue. This role combines regional programme leadership, brand governance, creative supervision and partner collaboration. You’ll help ensure opportunities are grounded in Pinterest’s consumer marketing priorities, consistent with our brand standards and practical to deliver, while supporting commercial outcomes. This is a marketing and partnership role that works closely with Sales; it is not a quota-carrying Sales position. jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer Position for Xsolla's Smart Wallet in Web3
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer who has tested real on-chain products — the contracts and the transactions, not only the web app in front of them. You will own quality for Xsolla's smart wallet on Xsolla ZK, our Ethereum-compatible ZK rollup: the wallet players use to hold, receive and send tokens and in-game items, signing in with the account they already have. The work runs on both sides of the chain. On the backend, you will confirm that a wallet address pre-computed from a salt is the address that actually gets deployed. On the frontend, you will follow a signed operation from the client's RPC call through the bundler to finality, and prove it landed, failed or reverted the way it should. You will fork the chain to test against real state, deploy and call contracts from the command line, and turn what you learn into automated suites. You will work in a small, senior engineering team alongside an external wallet-infrastructure partner. You can tell a defect in our code from one in a partner SDK or in the chain itself — and you bring the evidence to show which. AI coding tools are part of how you work every day, and you set them up so the rest of the team gets the same leverage.

About the Role We're looking for a Staff Engineer to own the smart wallet and account abstraction layer of Xsolla's Web3 platform. This is an individual contributor role with outsized technical scope: you'll be the technical anchor for how millions of players get an on-chain account they never have to think about — setting direction, making hard architectural calls, and raising the bar across the org. Concretely, you'll own the account model behind Xsolla ZK, our zkSync-based L2, and the wallet that sits inside Xsolla App. Every player who signs in with Xsolla ID receives a deterministic, non-custodial smart account — derived from their identity claim, identical on every device, with private keys that never leave the client. jobs.description_text: The Opportunity Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone. jobs.description_text: The Opportunity Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone. The Role As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems: Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio. In this role, you will set the standards for how process safety is managed across our projects and future assets, from design and construction through commissioning and operations. Working across Engineering, Projects, Operations and HSE, you will combine technical expertise with functional leadership to strengthen process safety across the organization. Your key responsibilities include: Develop and implement SkyNRG’s corporate Process Safety Management (PSM) framework as part of the Integrated Management System. Establish and embed process safety standards and procedures across current and future projects, including construction, commissioning, start-up and operations. Ensure compliance with SEVESO III requirements and support the Major Accident Prevention Policy, Safety Reports, regulatory inspections and audits. Govern key process safety activities, including HAZOP, LOPA, QRA and Management of Change (MOC). Develop and monitor process safety KPIs and barrier management to strengthen risk control and performance. Lead process safety audits, incident learning and improvement initiatives across projects and assets. Build process safety capability across the organization through training, guidance and functional leadership for Engineering, Projects, Operations, Maintenance and contractors.
